title: Understanding Position Sizing and the Kelly Criterion
description: A first-principles guide to position sizing for traders and investors who already have an edge but don't know how much to bet on it. Derive the Kelly Criterion from scratch, learn why full Kelly is too aggressive for real markets, and apply fractional Kelly and portfolio-level sizing to Indian equities, Nifty and Bank Nifty options, and futures.
